Context: 5. Leave Not Due

3. It is granted on medical certificate (Exception : 4 below) if the leave sanctioning authority is satisfied that there is a reasonable prospect of the Government servant returning to duty on its expiry. - Rule 31 (1).
4. It may be granted without medical certificate-
3. (a) in continuation of maternity leave.
- Rule 43 (4).
5. (b) to a female Government servant with less than two living children on adoption of a child less than a year old. - Rule 43-8.
